attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determines if corporation must file Michigan state tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair $100,000 threshold).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Michigan Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get apportionment.state_code get "MI" streq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus get apportionment.state_code get "MI" streq and

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "Michigan filing not required: No nexus established" job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: Michigan filing required due to physical presence
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Michigan filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). Reference: MCL 206.621 (Nexus requirements), MI Form 4567 Instructions"

policy_statement.policy_description: Michigan filing required due to economic nexus
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Michigan filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts or 200 transactions. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), Michigan Department of Treasury Revenue Administrative Bulletin 2018-16"

policy_statement.policy_description: No Michigan nexus - no filing requirement
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No Michigan nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded."

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates Michigan state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Includes federal bond interest addback, IRC 199A addback, bonus depreciation adjustments, and Michigan municipal bond interest subtraction.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Michigan Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Michigan state additions and subtractions

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "Michigan: No nexus - no state adjustments calculated" job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: Michigan state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Michigan state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. Additions may include: Interest on U.S. government obligations, IRC Section 199A deduction addback, Bonus depreciation (partial decoupling). Subtractions may include: Interest on Michigan municipal bonds, Michigan-specific NOL deduction. Reference: MI Form 4567 Instructions, MCL 206.623 (Adjustments to federal taxable income)"

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates final Michigan state corporate income tax. Applies 6% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income, subtracts state credits, and calculates refund or amount owed.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Michigan State Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Michigan tax at 6% flat rate
No taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "Michigan: No taxable income - no tax liability (Michigan NOL rules may apply)" job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "Michigan: No nexus - no tax liability" job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: Michigan state corporate income tax calculation (6% flat rate)
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Michigan state corporate income tax calculation: 1. Federal taxable income [Form 1120 line 28], 2. Apportioned to Michigan × [Apportionment %], 3. State additions + [Additions], 4. State subtractions - [Subtractions], 5. Michigan taxable income = [Result], 6. Michigan tax rate × 6.0%, 7. Michigan income tax = [Tax before credits], 8. Michigan credits - [Credits], 9. Michigan tax liability = [Final tax]. Reference: MI Form 4567 Instructions, MCL 206.623 (Tax rate: 6%), Michigan Department of Treasury Corporate Income Tax Guide"

policy_statement.policy_description: No Michigan taxable income - no tax liability
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No Michigan taxable income - no tax liability. Michigan NOL rules may apply (not implemented)."

policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No Michigan nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded."
